Overview

The project.

WordPress Plugin, Platform, Web design · Jan 2026 — Mar 2026

WordPress plugin made in PHP, JavaScript, HTML and CSS that turns a website into an independent multi vendor marketplace, without WooCommerce. Users buy time limited subscriptions with a quota, such as 1 shop and up to 6 products, and become sellers with a frontend dashboard for sales and earnings. Transactions are direct between people, without card payments, with an automatic Mark as Sold system and email notifications for buyers and sellers. It has its own cart, checkout and account pages, plus a one click demo data import.

Desktop 01

The api module registers custom REST endpoints for shops, products and user posts. In the example, the GET route api/mme/shop/{id} validates the ID, checks that the post is a mme_shop custom post type and returns its title, status, slug, description and featured image as JSON, with proper 400 and 404 errors when the request is invalid or the shop does not exist.

Case study

Plugin Architecture & REST API

The plugin is split into feature modules instead of one large file. Front end files live in assets (CSS, fonts, JS), while the logic sits in includes, with a folder for each part of the marketplace: account, admin, cart, checkout, order, product, shop, review, mail, cron, permalinks, shortcodes, templates, user fields and demo data. This keeps each feature isolated and easy to extend.
